name: jev-gate-router
description: Routes each request's Claude model and effort with one TypeSafe Jev assessment; off by default, native on any doubt.

enabled.title: Enable the Router
enabled.description: Off registers no hook at all. Every request keeps its native model and effort.

routeSubagentModel.title: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Choose the model of an inheriting built-in subagent (general-purpose, claude, Plan, Explore) that names none.

routeMainEffort.title: Route main-thread effort
routeMainEffort.description: Choose the effort of the main thread's requests, per turn.

routeMainModel.title: Route main-thread model
routeMainModel.description: Choose the model of the main thread's requests, per turn. Off by default.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Used only in the Authorization header of the assessment request. Blank reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

fastModel.title: Fast profile model
fastModel.description: Alias or exact model ID for the fast profile.

standardModel.title: Standard profile model
standardModel.description: Alias or exact model ID for the standard profile.

deepModel.title: Deep profile model
deepModel.description: Alias or exact model ID for the deep profile.

frontierModel.title: Frontier profile model
frontierModel.description: Exact model ID for the frontier profile. Blank leaves the profile unconfigured.

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Upgrade confidence floor
minUpgradeConfidence.description: Least confidence, 0.5 to 1, for a move to a stronger model or a higher effort.

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Downgrade confidence floor
minDowngradeConfidence.description: Least confidence, 0.5 to 1, for a move to a weaker model or a lower effort.

timeoutMs.title: Assessment wait (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long a request waits for the assessment, 50 to 30000. Past it the request runs natively.

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write one metadata-only line per decision to the debug log. Never task text or the key.
